description: Read a published RSS 2.0 / RSS 1.0 / Atom / JSON Feed (blogs, news, podcasts, Reddit, Mastodon, YouTube channel feeds) as clean JSON items: title, link, ISO dates, author, plain-text summary/content, categories, enclosures. An HTML page URL is followed to its advertised feed. robots.txt respected; nothing stored; social networks are not scraped. Paid ($0.0003, x402).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

url.description: Feed URL, or a page that advertises a feed
